description: This file defines a class 'Image_Graph_Axis_Marker_Line' that extends 'Image_Graph_Grid'. The class represents a marker line on an axis in a graph, allowing setting of a specific value and rendering a line at that position on the graph, with methods for drawing on a canvas. It includes methods to set the marker value, perform drawing, and handle axis and coordinate calculations.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Marker_Line
classes.description: A class to create a marker line on a graph axis at a specified value, extending the functionality of Image_Graph_Grid.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value on the axis at which the marker line will be displayed.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the marker line on the canvas at the specified axis value, handling the drawing between secondary axis points.
